Mapping Housing Availability

📅 2026-07-08 ✍️ David Kertai (Center for Data Innovation) 🏷️ housing data, data visualization, Massachusetts, Census data, interactive maps, housing policy
🔗 Read the source article →

💡 Quick summary

Massachusetts has launched a statewide interactive housing data visualization portal that tracks home construction progress using U.S. Census address records, showing 34,500 homes added in 2025 — about 15% of the state's 2035 production goal.

📌 Key takeaways

  • The Massachusetts government launched a statewide housing data visualization portal tracking home construction
  • The portal draws on U.S. Census address records to monitor housing production
  • 34,500 homes were added in 2025, representing approximately 15% of the state's housing production goal for 2035
  • An interactive map uses color gradients (darker blue = more homes built, lighter = fewer) for easy geographic comparison
  • The tool serves both residents and policymakers in tracking progress toward housing targets
